verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Bitwarden generates TOTP codes, syncs them between apps and imports them from other authenticators. Nothing in the pack documents searching codes, sorting them into folders or groups, or showing service icons. The Public API's 'collections, groups' refers to organization member management, an adjacent feature that does not organize tokens, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, I can keep dozens of tokens organized — search, folders or groups, and service icons — so the right code is always two taps away
